asm-no-end.reason: ASM88 only warns when END is missing; SIM88 makes it an error (decision 6 in PROGRESS.md).

hand-printer-polling.reason: MSX88 prints in real time, so BUSY is still 1 after the 4th character; SIM88 prints one character every N instructions (the printer speed setting).

printer-crlf.reason: MSX88's printer ignores CR (only LF starts a new line); SIM88 treats CR, LF and CR LF as one new line. Waiting for a decision.

printer-cdma-block.reason: In block mode to the printer MSX88 only gets the first 4 characters onto the paper (the buffer); SIM88 waits for DREQ and prints them all. Waiting for a decision.
